meaning: Derives the #166 first-being bridge through the quarta via, relocating its gap into two narrower explicit open premises: STMT-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD (the maximal being is the God of q.105 a.5) and STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING (q.3 a.1's simple priority is causation of being). With them, nothing other than the maximal being is simply prior to it (Metaphysics II.1: a cause of another's being is more a being), and every first mover moved by none is that maximal being. The Comparator config also verifies four countermodels, one for each of q.105 a.5, the two open premises and Metaphysics II.1 (each is needed), and premisesJointlySatisfiable (all premises of the #147 results, the prima via premises and act's simple priority hold in one finite model with a caused agent that moves and is moved).
